violations.text: Establishment's Rhode Island Manager Certified In Food Safety license is expired. Food safety certificate is active. FMC to re-instate. Application provided during time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 11/26/2026

The handle for the 1 door reach-in was observed held with duct tape and other adhesive stickers. Nonfood contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other food soiling or that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. New Violation. Correct By: 12/12/2026

1 door reach in was observed held at an ambient of 44 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Foods in unit were evaluated at the time of inspection. 1 door reach in's dial was adjusted and held an ambient of 41 DF at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/30/2024

The dish washing machine was observed in poor repair. Establishment is using 3-bay sink to wash rinse and sanitize and should not use dish washing machine until it is properly adjusted and serviced. New Violation. Correct By: 10/30/2024
